text:
michelle (Support): FYI customer AcmeHealth hit a 400 on /v1/tool/invoke, claiming it worked yesterday. Error: JSON schema validation failed (additionalProperties) and also a type mismatch for billingProfile. Ticket #CS-9834

raj (API): can you paste the exact payload they sent?

michelle (Support): pasted below from the customer's logs — they say SDK v2.1.0.
```json
{
  "tool": "invoice_generator",
  "params": { "invoice_id": 12345 },
  "auth_id": "user_987",        // new top-level key client added
  "billingProfile": "corp-acme"  // used to be object, now string
}
```

sre-bot: Automated: validation_error: additionalProperties [auth_id] at /, schema expects properties [tool, params, auth, billingProfile].

olivia (SRE): ah — schema expects `auth` object with `user_id` but customer has `auth_id` top-level. Also billingProfile should be an object {id:..., plan:...} not a string. Likely SDK change.

sam (Client SDK): confirmed SDK v2.1.0 introduced a convenience field `auth_id` for client-side lookup, but server contract didn't change. That was intended to be converted client-side into `auth: {user_id: ...}` but looks like some clients send it raw.

raj (API): reproduce steps for us: 1) call /v1/tool/invoke with that JSON; 2) expect 400 with additionalProperties for auth_id; 3) also note billingProfile type mismatch. I can repro locally with a curl.

michelle (Support): customer says they updated overnight and all calls started failing at ~2026-03-16T03:22Z (they rolled SDK). They want either a hotfix or a mitigation on our side.

olivia (SRE): immediate mitigation options: 1) gateway transform that maps top-level `auth_id` -> `auth.user_id` and coerces billingProfile string -> {id:that, plan: null} for now; 2) relax schema (additionalProperties: true) — not preferred; 3) tell customers to pin older SDK and push patch.

sam (Client SDK): we should ship a patch to the SDK to ensure clients transform before send, but that won't help already-updated customers. Gateway transform seems safest short-term.

raj (API): I can add a lightweight request middleware to normalize fields for the tool invoke route. Will make it opt-in per-tenant (feature flag) and then enable for AcmeHealth. Low risk.

olivia (SRE): escalate to eng-oncall so they can approve deploy. Create a small rollout: feature flag + add test that ensures explicit rejection still happens if both `auth` and `auth_id` are present (to avoid spoofing).

michelle (Support): approving for AcmeHealth only, they asked for ETA — can we get roll to staging in 1-2 hours and prod in next maintenance window?

raj (API): pushing branch now: `feat/normalizer/gateway-auth-id`. Staging build in ~30m. I'll post link to PR. :eyes:

olivia (SRE): tagging oncall: @sre-oncall for deploy approval. Also create internal incident so Eng + Support can track (INC-2026-042).

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created and linked to CS-9834.

sam (Client SDK): I'll prepare an SDK patch and publish a hotfix note for customers. Also will add a telemetry flag to detect who sends `auth_id` raw.

michelle (Support): thanks all — I've messaged AcmeHealth with mitigation plan and told them we'll enable tenant flag. Will update ticket when staging deploy validated. :thumbsup:

raj (API): staging deploy succeeded, normalization test added. invoking the same payload returns 200 and the tool executes (reproduced with local run).

michelle (Support): customer confirms calls succeed after we enabled flag for them. Closing CS-9834 after follow-up tomorrow for SDK patch and schema doc update. :white_check_mark:
